The '''Hotel Sharu''' was an [[Hotel/Legends|inn]] located on [[Rafa IV]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] stayed there in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. During the night, he was arrested for acquiring an unlicensed cargo and other trumped-up charges, beaten, and taken to see the local governor, [[Duttes Mer]].
